verified_findings.evidence: penname-v3/manuscript/chapter-21-midyear-open-rounds.md:209-209: The arena was the standard Open floor: a ring eleven meters across... It also changes the source’s three unanswered Julian points and Priya’s 2-2 score to four unanswered points and 3-3, respectively, producing direct scoring-continuity violations.
